Options for Translating Other Responses

ck_translate_options.Rd

Settings used by translate_other_responses() and by prepare_other_responses(translate = TRUE). The defaults are chosen to stay well inside what Google's free translation service tolerates and to send as little as possible; most users only set cache_file.

Usage

ck_translate_options(
  mask_numbers = TRUE,
  cache_file = NULL,
  target_language = "en",
  pause = 0.5,
  max_retries = 4,
  retry_wait = 2,
  batch_size = 50,
  batch_chars = 4000,
  timeout = 30
)

Arguments

mask_numbers

Logical. If TRUE (the default), any run of five or more digits - a phone number, an ID, a bank or case number, even with spaces, dashes, brackets or a leading + - is replaced by ##### before the text is sent. Shorter numbers such as ages or years written as two digits are kept, because they are rarely identifying and often matter for the meaning.

cache_file

Optional path to an .rds file. Every text that has been translated is saved there (after each batch), and a later run only sends texts that are not in it yet. Use one cache per project; it contains the response texts, so keep it with the data and never commit or share it. NULL (the default) keeps no cache.

target_language

Language code to translate into. Default "en".

pause

Seconds to wait between two requests. Default 0.5.

max_retries

How many times a request is retried after a "too many requests" reply, a server error or a lost connection. Default 4.

retry_wait

Seconds to wait before the first retry. The wait doubles with each further retry (2, 4, 8, 16 seconds with the defaults).

batch_size

Maximum number of texts sent in one request. Default 50.

batch_chars

Maximum number of characters sent in one request. Google rejects requests much above 5000 characters. Default 4000.

timeout

Seconds to wait for one reply before giving up on it. Default 30.

Value

A named list of the settings.

See also

translate_other_responses()

Examples

ck_translate_options(cache_file = "output/translation_cache.rds")
#> $mask_numbers
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $cache_file
#> [1] "output/translation_cache.rds"
#> 
#> $target_language
#> [1] "en"
#> 
#> $pause
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $max_retries
#> [1] 4
#> 
#> $retry_wait
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $batch_size
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $batch_chars
#> [1] 4000
#> 
#> $timeout
#> [1] 30
#>
